description: Header file defining the Store2 class implementing various storage interfaces with SQLite backend, including methods for data management, integrity checks, backup, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: Implements storage, cache, inspection, and limit interfaces using SQLite, with methods for data manipulation, integrity, backup, and event notification.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class for dispatching value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: TempDirectoryCheck
methods.description: Checks and fixes issues with temporary journal directory.

methods.name: IntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs integrity check on the SQLite database.

methods.name: Backup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database, handling corruption scenarios.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the SQLite database and initializes schema with triggers.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the SQLite database connection.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks if system time is synchronized (platform-specific).

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for store events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store with optional TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace.

methods.name: FlushCache
methods.description: Flushes the SQLite cache.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys in a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves all namespace names.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Gets size info for all namespaces.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a value change.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Logs SQLite error details.
